capability.title: Generate Video Script
capability.summary: A shot-by-shot script whose beat structure comes from the vertical's `shot_grammar`. This is the mechanism that makes one video factory produce a UGC unboxing for DTC, a before/after for a plumber and an annotated mechanism walkthrough for an equipment maker — same workflow, different grammar.

motion.description: How the frame moves: push in, pan, static, handheld. Fed straight to the clip generator.
